manifest.description: Report the public-API delta a proposed Java refactor would produce, as an advisory severity (info / caution / breaking). Mirrors rust-public-api-guard.
when_to_use: about to run a refactor that may touch public Java surfaces (visibility rewrites, type-use migration, error-type changes on pub methods)
preflight before java-extract-interface when callers may live in other Maven/Gradle modules
auditing a proposed change set for cross-module impact
anti_patterns: do not use as a permission grant — this atom reports the delta, it does not decide whether the change is safe
do not use on non-Java files
do not chain inside a mutating bbox_refactor_run — keep the guard as a separate preflight

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the Java project root.

source.description: File or directory to analyze, relative to project_dir. Directory walks recursively, skipping target/, build/, .gradle/, node_modules/, .git/.

proposed_changes.description: Optional list of proposed-change refs (file + item_name + change_kind=modify|remove|add). When provided, the guard scopes its report to these items. When omitted, the guard reports zero changes — useful for module-boundary-only audits once Maven/Gradle awareness lands.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-public-api-guard. Charter: Report the public-API delta of a proposed Java refactor as an advisory severity.

Protocol (analysis-only — steps 3 and 4 are skipped):

1. Ground the target structurally:
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="",
                     languages=["java"], item_kinds=["class_declaration", "method_declaration", "field_declaration"])
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   Confirm the path resolves and tree-sitter parses cleanly. For each
   entry in {{proposed_changes}}, confirm `file` and `item_name` resolve
   in the inventory.

2. Plan with deep_analysis=true:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_public_api_guard", deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}",
                      toml_entries={"proposed_changes": {{proposed_changes}}})
   The response carries advisory_severity (info|caution|breaking),
   public_items_touched, public_api_delta_summary (added_public,
   removed_public, modified_signatures), and module_boundaries_affected.
   Do not invoke bbox_refactor_run — analysis only.

   Severity rules (mirrored from the plan kind):
   - breaking — public/protected item removed or signature-modified, OR
     touched item is in a module-info.java `exports` clause (v2 add;
     module_boundaries_affected is empty in v1).
   - caution — package-private (default-visibility) item removed or
     modified. Operator should chain java-find-usages (rename_java_symbol
     plan kind's analysis sibling) to confirm cross-package callers.
   - info — only private items touched, OR every change is an addition.

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line summary: severity, touched
     count, public_api_delta_summary counts, source>).

Strict refusal rules (prompt-discipline; not enforced at dispatch):
- Never call any tool outside your filter_overlay.
- Never use this atom's output as a permission grant — it advises;
  the caller (or chained mutating atom) decides whether the change
  is acceptable.
- Never invent symbol names from the user prompt.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{proposed_changes}}

module_boundaries_affected.description: Empty in v1 — Maven/Gradle multi-module + module-info.java awareness lands in v2 of the plan kind.
